{{Quote|The C-point CE declared a bug-out right after the first major flare incident, and the whole Exec Sec evaced along with practically all the C-point civpop.|Jenica Sonsen|<ref name="SAC" />}}
The '''Executive Secretariat''', or '''Exec Sec''' were the rulers of [[Centerpoint Station]]. Its members were assigned by the [[Federation of the Double Worlds]] and it was headed by a [[Chief Executive (Executive Secretariat)|Chief Executive]]. [[Administration (Executive Secretariat)|Administration]] and [[Operations (Executive Secretariat)|Operations]] were parts of the Executive Secretariat.
